tackle.action: a physical tackle or bite: frame 1 ready stance (the reference pose), frame 2 crouch low and pull back away from the target, frame 3 lunge the head, chest and front legs far toward the target with the mouth open to bite, frame 4 recover halfway back toward the ready stance; the feet stay on the ground

special.action: an elemental special move WITHOUT drawing the element: frame 1 ready stance (the reference pose), frame 2 plant the feet wide and draw the head back inhaling with the chest swelling, frame 3 thrust the head and neck toward the target with the mouth wide open as if blasting a beam out of it (draw NO fire, water, leaves, beam or particles), frame 4 hold the mouth open slightly less; the body stays in place

buff.action: powering up: frame 1 ready stance (the reference pose), frame 2 crouch and tense the whole body, frame 3 rear up tall with the chest puffed out and the head raised, roaring, frame 4 settle back toward the ready stance; it stays in place and keeps facing the same way

hurt.action: taking a hit: frame 1 ready stance (the reference pose), frame 2 recoil away from the attacker, the head knocked back, eyes squeezed shut and the body flinching, frame 3 recovering most of the way back toward the ready stance

species.design: The evolved form of the dozemite mantis: a taller young mantis standing upright on four thin legs, a slim lilac and violet body, a big triangular head with big bright round eyes (large dark pupils with a 2x2 white sparkle, friendly), two curly antennae.
species.signature: two huge curved scythe arms, each as long as its body, with thin glowing mint-green membranes along the blades
species.palette: lilac, violet, pale cream, dark purple

species.name: 오라클온
species.design: The final evolved form of the trancescythe mantis: a large noble mantis standing upright on four legs, a broad heavy lilac and violet body clearly bigger and bulkier than trancescythe, two big scythe arms held open, a big head with big bright round eyes (large dark pupils with a 2x2 white sparkle, friendly) (calm and wise).
species.signature: a gigantic diamond-shaped mint-green crystal on its forehead with two wide glowing wing-like sheets of light spreading behind its shoulders, wider than its body
species.accent: mint green (only the crystal and light sheets)
species.palette: lilac, violet, pale cream, dark purple

species.name: 마리오네
species.design: A small floating puppet ghost: a big round slate-blue cloth head with a pale cream face, big bright round eyes (large dark pupils with a 2x2 white sparkle, friendly) and a little smile, a short ragged cloth body with two tiny stubby arms, no legs.
species.signature: a big wooden puppet cross-bar floating above its head with four long cream strings tied to its head and arms
species.accent: warm orange (only the button on its chest)
species.palette: slate blue, dark navy, pale cream, wood brown

species.name: 팬텀돌
species.design: The evolved form of the threadimp puppet: a taller floating cloth doll ghost, a round slate-blue head with a pale cream face and big bright round eyes (large dark pupils with a 2x2 white sparkle, friendly), a body wrapped in an old dark navy cloth, two cloth arms.
species.signature: a huge stitched heart-shaped patch on its chest with big cross stitches, as wide as its body, and a long trailing torn cloth hem below
species.palette: slate blue, dark navy, pale cream, wood brown

species.name: 녹턴베일
species.design: The final evolved form of the hushdoll puppet: a large floating puppeteer ghost, a broad heavy body clearly bigger than hushdoll wrapped in a long dark navy stage curtain, a big pale cream face with big bright round eyes (large dark pupils with a 2x2 white sparkle, friendly) (calm and wise), two long arms holding strings.
species.signature: a gigantic theater mask hat on its head - a big orange half-moon mask with a wide brim, as wide as its body
species.palette: slate blue, dark navy, pale cream, wood brown

species.name: 청비오
species.design: A baby marsh bird chick standing on two thin legs: a big round teal-green head and a plump round teal body with a cream belly, big bright round eyes (large dark pupils with a 2x2 white sparkle, friendly), small folded wings.
species.signature: a very long thin pointed yellow beak, as long as its whole body, held straight forward
species.accent: sunny yellow (only the beak and feet)
species.palette: teal green, dark teal, cream, navy

species.name: 블루헤론
species.design: The evolved form of the reedpeep chick: a taller young marsh wading bird on two long thin legs, a teal-green body with a cream belly, a long curved neck, a round head with big bright round eyes (large dark pupils with a 2x2 white sparkle, friendly), a long yellow beak.
species.signature: two very long stilt legs as tall as its body with bright wave-pattern bands, and a round tuft crest on its head
species.accent: sunny yellow (only the beak and leg bands)
species.palette: teal green, dark teal, cream, navy

species.name: 미스트랄
species.design: The final evolved form of the fenstrider bird: a large elegant mist heron standing tall on two long legs, a broad heavy teal-green body clearly bigger than fenstrider with wings half open, a cream belly, a short thick curved neck, a BIG round cream-faced head facing the viewer with two big bright round eyes (large dark pupils with a 2x2 white sparkle, friendly, calm and wise), a short yellow beak.
species.signature: a gigantic sweeping crest of long yellow-tipped plumes on its head and a long flowing tail of mist-white feathers, together longer than its body
species.accent: sunny yellow (only the beak and plume tips)
species.palette: teal green, dark teal, cream, navy

species.name: 뇌제라칸
species.design: A legendary storm ibex standing on four sturdy hooved legs: a strong stocky body of golden fur with grey stone armor plates on its shoulders and back, a cream face with big bright round eyes (large dark pupils with a 2x2 white sparkle, friendly) (calm and wise), a short beard.
species.signature: two gigantic curling horns sweeping back from its head like lightning bolts, each as long as its body, sky blue with jagged zig-zag edges
species.palette: gold, grey stone, cream, dark brown

species.name: 빙화세라
species.design: A legendary moon crane drawn in a cute chibi style: a plump round white body on two short thin legs, a BIG round white head nearly as wide as the body with a cream face and two huge round navy eyes (each eye a solid 4x4 dark pupil with a 2x2 white sparkle, friendly, calm and wise), a short pale beak, a small crescent-moon crest on top of the head.
species.signature: two big wings raised up beside its body, white feathers with long lavender ice-crystal quill tips
species.accent: lavender (only the ice quill tips and a crest)
species.palette: white, pale ice blue, slate blue, navy

species.name: 솔라레온
species.design: A legendary sun lion sitting proudly on four strong paws: a powerful golden-yellow body with a cream muzzle and chest, big bright round eyes (large dark pupils with a 2x2 white sparkle, friendly) (brave), a long tail ending in a round flame tuft.
species.signature: a gigantic blazing sun mane around its whole head, shaped like a big round sunburst of pointed orange and gold flame spikes, wider than its body
species.accent: flame orange (only the sunburst mane tips and tail tuft)
species.palette: golden yellow, cream, rust brown, dark brown

species.name: 루나만타

species.signature: two gigantic wide wing fins spread out to both sides like a moonlit kite, much wider than its body, with four bright mint-green star spots on them
species.accent: mint green (only the star spots and a crest gem)
species.palette: lavender blue, dark indigo, pale cream, navy

species.name: 스카라킹
species.design: A legendary ancient scarab beetle standing on six sturdy legs: a big round golden-brown shell with carved stone rune patterns, a cream face with big bright round eyes (large dark pupils with a 2x2 white sparkle, friendly) (calm and wise), translucent teal wings half open behind the shell.
species.signature: a gigantic ornate golden horn rising from its head shaped like an ancient key with a round ring on top, taller than its head
species.accent: teal (only the wings and the rune glow)
species.palette: gold, bronze brown, cream, dark brown

species.name: 아스트록
species.design: A legendary spirit stag standing on four long slender legs: a graceful pale-green body with dark green leaf patterns, a cream face and chest, big bright round eyes (large dark pupils with a 2x2 white sparkle, friendly) (calm and wise), a short white tail.
species.signature: a gigantic pair of glowing antlers branching like a starry tree, wider and taller than its body, with small pale-yellow star lights on every tip

species.palette: pale green, dark green, cream, navy
